def: The long-term maintenance cost ML systems accrue beyond ordinary code debt, through entanglement, hidden feedback loops, undeclared consumers, unstable data dependencies, configuration sprawl, glue code and pipeline jungles.
practice: Named in Sculley et al.'s 'Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems' (NIPS 2015); LLM systems repeat it as tangled prompts, undeclared consumers of model output and unversioned eval data.
